title: The Barrier Master's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the courses that doubles the plate and adds a ward that holds against any one blow.

title: A Treatise on Unyielding Cover
summary: A treatise on wards that do not give ground and that pin an attacker who leans on them too long.

title: The Canon of Warding Fields
summary: A canon of rounded wards that grow from the qi field and shelter the user and those within the field's reach.

title: The Ward Beyond the Body
summary: Teaches how the qi field carries a ward away from the body to cover an ally at a distance and turn harm aside there.

title: The Twin Court Barrier Course
summary: A course of the twin court that teaches wards in facing pairs and a verdict stroke that ends the pair's exchange.

title: Manual of the Paired Azure Shield
summary: A manual of the azure sky that sets two wards side by side and drops a canopy over the pair like a hawk's wing.

title: The River Basin Warding Course
summary: A course that teaches the ward to run like a river round the user and to wash taint out of the wounded.

title: The Wind-Sworn Shield Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn that binds the ward to an oath and lets a gale of qi turn aside what the oath guards.

title: A Plateau Oath of Warding
summary: A short oath-manual that ties each ward to a spoken bearing and teaches how to keep it through a long hard exchange.

title: The Unwalled Bearing Course
summary: A course that guards by bearing and by open ward rather than by any fixed barrier and that is taught on the edge of the plateau.
